$comment: Office categories for the P&L dashboard. Each dimension assigns every office to one category; the dashboard can filter to a category, compare categories and group the Analysis tab by them. type 'rules': the first rule that matches wins; match is a case-insensitive regular expression on the office name, offices lists exact office names or QuickBooks company IDs. type 'platformGroups': uses the entity groups set on the Entities page in Ledgerview. Offices with no match go to otherLabel. Restart the server after editing.
